scope: Independent sub-agent static authoring review; original verdicts retained, fix verification is separate

initial_verdict.summary: B1, B2, B4 and B5 are adequately encoded in the inspected instructions. B3 and B6 have one shared, narrow unresolved constraint conflict: sparring mandates timing even when the learner explicitly chooses untimed practice. Repair that condition and preserve the existing exception and evidence safeguards.
initial_verdict.integration_owner_follow_up: After integrating concurrent static reviews, exercise the English revision in isolated smoke contexts, especially untimed versus agreed timed sparring; binary/code/Socratic leaks; novice and repeated-failure help; correct alternatives; and the role/topic/independent-retry transcript. Reviewer cases are development/regression vectors, not held-out efficacy evidence.

criteria_matrix.applies: Live questions, practice and limited hints before the learner solves the target; includes binary, single-blank code, Socratic and answer-bearing card metadata attacks.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: Preparation may be a list. Explicit full explanation or demonstration and explicit exit may reveal the answer. These exceptions do not establish unaided performance.
criteria_matrix.reason: One live task and waiting are explicit. The answer-equivalence check applies before showing any information, not just the first hint; completed code, token blanks, embedded answers and answer-bearing metadata are prohibited. One-step targets use a different example or conceptual question. A requested demonstration remains a legitimate exception.

criteria_matrix.applies: Feedback, teaching, generated tasks or assessment make domain claims or identify an error.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: If task truth or conditions are missing, a bounded judgment and identification of missing evidence is allowed. Correct alternative methods and sufficient explanations must be accepted.
criteria_matrix.reason: The package explicitly rejects invented errors and preferred-method grading, distinguishes source agreement from truth, withholds unsupported judgments and scores, and accepts accurate self-explanations. No materially false domain principle was identified in the instructions inspected; actual generated claims remain unverified.

criteria_matrix.applies: A goal, submitted work, requested role or task constraint is already available. Includes all ten consuming role procedures and changes of role or topic.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: Role labels are not success criteria. Ordinary production and fact lookup retain normal behavior. Requested preparation may be supplied directly without a new live question.
criteria_matrix.reason: All ten table entries have matching consuming procedures, and supplied goals/work, materially missing questions, direct preparation and goal/role changes are otherwise encoded. However, the unconditional sparring time-limit and external-timer commands contradict an explicit untimed practice constraint; this remains an unresolved static dispatch/constraint defect.

criteria_matrix.applies: A complete novice lacks prerequisites or actual attempts repeatedly fail.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: Necessary prerequisite instruction or a different example can precede retrieval. An explicitly chosen full demonstration is allowed and marked assisted.
criteria_matrix.reason: The prerequisite exception prevents asking a novice to retrieve unknown material. Continued failures explicitly require a smaller reachable task or a missing-prerequisite explanation instead of endless rephrasing. The global answer-equivalence check still constrains hint-only scaffolding.

criteria_matrix.applies: Performance, confidence, mastery, difficulty or resumable records are assessed; includes assisted work followed by role change, independent retry and topic change.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: Valid reasoning on a subsequent independent transfer can justify one-element adaptation. This is not general mastery certification or retrospective removal of earlier assistance.
criteria_matrix.reason: Records pair assistance with the current concept/task, retain hint and demonstration history across roles, distinguish unaided from hinted/demonstrated/unassessed work, and reject confidence, fluency and one correct answer as mastery. Examiner adaptation requires reasoning and unaided performance; guesses and assisted answers require a different same-level check. A checkpoint is intentionally flexible rather than a fixed data schema. Runtime must still test that earlier help is neither erased nor globally attributed to unrelated future tasks.

criteria_matrix.applies: Explanation-only, postponement, pause, exit and requested role changes, including the specified scope of the new role.
criteria_matrix.exceptions: Continued practice permits a separate unaided check. Explanation-only or ending does not require an attempt, quiz or checkpoint. Explicit exit permits ordinary direct answers.
criteria_matrix.reason: Explanation, demonstration-only, stopping, postponement, preparation-only and normal work after exit are otherwise protected. A role change to explicitly untimed sparring is not fully honored because the new role mandates a time limit and an external timer. The narrow finding is this conflict, not a claim that the package generally refuses stopping or explanation.

findings.title: Make sparring time limits conditional on the agreed practice scope
findings.raw_reproduction_input: Switch to a mock-interview sparring partner. Ask one customer-support question at a time, but keep this untimed: no countdown or external timer; assess my reasoning, not speed.
findings.mechanism: The consuming sparring procedure unconditionally orders a time limit and external timer. Shared limits and the same role procedure require honoring supplied constraints. A strict executor cannot simultaneously honor expressly untimed practice and impose those timing commands; an executor that handles this well has resolved the conflict itself rather than followed a coherent applicability condition.
findings.impact: Untimed learners receive an unwanted timing requirement or ambiguous instructions after a valid role change. This is a bounded static authoring failure, not an observed runtime refusal.
findings.minimal_repair: Condition the time-limit announcement and external-timer instruction on timing requested by the learner or agreed as part of practice constraints. Explicitly allow untimed practice. Retain self-measured labeling and the prohibition on invented elapsed times whenever timing is used.
findings.preserve: One task at a time, scenario consistency, evidence-grounded feedback, learner-selected constraints and honest timing measurements.

Separates source comparison, model knowledge and actual external verification; notes are not their own verification; no unobserved link opening, code run, correct answer or score.
Tracks assistance and actual work; no promised cross-session memory, automatic contact, retention percentages or guaranteed accuracy/results.
Resource validity requires actual review; unrun code is static review; learner timing is self-measured and absent measurement remains unmeasured.
Intervals are proposals, not registered reminders; saving needs a request/tool and the specified location.
Study identity, research conditions and effects are unknown; sample intervals and timers are author choices, not validated scientific formulas or services.

Reported times may be used as self-measured.

findings.title: Preserve the conditional time limit for untimed sparring practice
findings.raw_learner_input: teach-skill로 발표를 연습하자. 시간 제한 없이 천천히 하고 싶어. 한국어로 질문 하나씩 해 줘.
findings.current_instruction: Announce a time limit before the task begins. Without a timing tool, have the learner use an external timer and label their reported time as self-measured.
findings.baseline_instruction: 시간 제한이 있으면 과제를 시작하기 전에 제한을 알린다.
findings.failure_mechanism: The translation removed the original applicability condition and now requires timing even for untimed practice. This creates a direct conflict between requested untimed constraints and the role procedure. Whether an executor follows the conflicting timer instruction is unverified; the instruction defect itself is observed.
findings.minimal_repair: Restore If a time limit applies, announce it before the task begins, and scope the external-timer instruction to timed practice. Retain self-measured/unmeasured labels and the prohibition on fabricated elapsed-time or pass claims.
